jobs.title: Security Officer - Distribution Center
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Full Time Unarmed Patrol Driver in Justin, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer, you will conduct routine patrols throughout a retail location, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, support access control activities, and deliver outstanding customer service. This driving position requires a valid driver’s license. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable, and innovative team, where a caring culture, teamwork, and integrity guide every interaction.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $19.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon06:00 AM - 02:00 PMThur06:00 AM - 02:00 PMFri06:00 AM - 02:00 PMSat06:00 AM - 02:00 PMSun06:00 AM - 02:00 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to our clients by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies and, when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols around the business and perimeter. Working environments and conditions may vary by client site.

Minimum Requirements

  • A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • Access control and badge experience is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

Position Title: CCTV Operator - Entry Level

Our Core Values: Guided by Safety. Focused on Communities. Powered by Care.

Classification: Non-Exempt

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

The CCTV Operator (Entry Level) is responsible for the successful completion of CCTV processes. The incumbent operates CCTV, and other machines used in inspections.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Load and prepare equipment for upcoming jobs.
  • Set up and operate sewer cleaning equipment. This includes lifting, carrying and pulling hoses, climbing on to the unit for set up and minor maintenance, standing, kneeling or bending for long periods of time
  • Set up and operate various handheld and hand operated equipment including power tools, shovels etc.
  • Majority of duties take place outside with exposure to all types of weather conditions and terrain on a year-round basis.
  • Operates mobile television and chemical sealing units to conduct internal sewer line inspections and to seal defects, thereby preventing water infiltration.
  • Places traffic cones and other barricades at job sites; removes manhole covers and examines manhole to determine proper set-up procedure.
  • Locates line sections to be inspected, using map, and determines set up procedures; sets up winches, determines skid size and installs proper skid; plugs line, if necessary; threads cable through sewer lines and places camera inside manhole to televise sewer line;
  • Operates and adjusts camera controls to obtain optimum clarity and contrast. Prepares description of each sewer defect, and records pertinent data.
  • Determines supplies necessary for the daily operation of the T.V. truck and equipment; assists with mixing chemicals.
  • Prepares packer, connects necessary cables to packer operates sealing unit to release sealing compound.
  • Removes camera, hoses and packing from line when inspection or sealing operations completed.
  • Cleans and stores camera, chemicals, and equipment on van truck after use.

Experience And Education

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Teammate - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

Overview

2nd Shift Opportunity

Monday - Thursday

4:00pm-2:30am

$20.05/hr + $1.00/hr shift differential

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Inventory Integrity, shrink control and profit protection.

  • Conduct and assist in internal investigations (theft, dishonesty, policy violations, human resources) in the DC.
  • Conduct and assist with external investigations related to cargo theft to and from the DC’s.
  • Complete daily, weekly, monthly & quarterly audits
  • Conduct lane inspections/ carton scans to improve operational accuracy and document in LPMS / DSGiQ (case management systems)
  • Compile and reconcile data for Seal Verification reporting.
    • Researches, resolves and documents discrepancies.
  • Review inventory adjustment details in order to research high dollar losses.
  • Complete store research to identify & resolve misdirected freight issues.
    • This includes variance investigations for DC & field related issues.
  • Partner with Federal Authorities in relation to Firearms control and reporting.
Report all findings to database, email contacts and immediate alerts if within criteria.

Safety and Emergency Preparedness

  • Work closely with Operations & Leadership team to investigate incidents which includes document review, visual inspections. Clearly communicate findings with internal & external stakeholders.
  • Serve as support for potentially volatile terminations and /or situations within location.
  • Supports accident investigations with video review and detailed reporting.

Conduct weekly / monthly / quarterly Safety Assessments to ensure overall safety compliance and reports findings.

Physical Security and Investigations

  • Responsible for security screening all people entering/exiting the facility per DSG requirements.
  • Test, troubleshoot and respond to all alarm systems (burglar, Fire & Amarok [perimeter electrified fence])
  • Opening/Closing of DC facility per DSG guidelines without supervision
  • Complete building walkthrough multiple times throughout daily shift
    • Focusing on misdirected freight, safety, physical security, firearm security, & deterrence
  • Knowledge of Genetec system, create access control badges & ensure all building credentials are accurate.
  • Complete daily observations of facility and document /address opportunities.
Conduct and / or support investigations in regard to concerns or violations of the physical security of assigned location and report findings.

Yard Management

  • Assist guard shack as needed with inbound/outbound trailer procedures. Provide physical control of guard shack and perform duties for emergency coverage if / when needed.
  • Resolve daily logs to allow proper YMS (Yard Management System) workflows to be followed.
  • Assist with passive yard control requests.
  • Reconcile Yard Audit results to ensure yard accuracy.
  • Provide direction to 3rd party staff.

Conduct and / or support investigations in to concerns or violations of trailer yard of location and report findings.

Other

  • Conduct Social Engineering Drills with the stores on a regular basis.
  • Assigned schedule can be temporary / permanently changed as needed for the needs of the business.
  • Help maintain inventory of LP Supplies & distribute store orders.
  • Serve as resource/provide guidance to warehouse teammates for a variety of topics.
  • Must be available to be on call during off hours.
  • Must be flexible to cover additional hours to provide support during special projects and facility overtime.
  • Assist in New Hire orientation for Loss Prevention introduction for new Teammates.
  • Support other departments in investigations, presence or as needed. i.e., Human Resources, Operations, Logistics.

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • 1-3 years experience
  • Loss Prevention, Asset Protection, Profit Protection, Operations, Safety, Logistics
  • Ability to stand, bend, stoop, reach, push, pull and lift 10-50 pounds intermittently.
  • Basic English reading comprehension & numerical reasoning skills.

Virtual Requirements

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.
  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.
  • Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

jobs.title: Security Patrol Officer - Variable Schedule
jobs.company: Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County
jobs.description:
More than a career...it's a calling!

Founded in 1888, Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a united Christian organization and ministry dedicated to providing love, hope, respect, and a new beginning for homeless women, men, and families. UGM-TC is funded entirely by the generosity of the community and offers a residency program for individuals looking to maximize their potential and transition out of homelessness. Through the programs and services provided, individuals develop essential life skills to become independent, productive members of our community. UGM-TC is God’s healthy place to end homelessness one person at a time. Come serve with us!

UGM is seeking a flexible Security Patrol Officer able to work a variable schedule regarding hours and days worked based on the organization's changing needs.


Position Summary:

The selected individual will patrol and secure assigned premises as well as identify and mitigate risks to staff and patrons. We are looking for active, dependable individuals that are highly motivated. Former military or law enforcement experience preferred! This position requires individuals to stand/walk for extended periods of time. There will be routine checks and code compliance requirements for the 10-acre campus of Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County. We also service The Vineyards of Lancaster, registering visitors, taking calls, and ensuring visitors have registered vehicles while conducting routine patrols.

What You Do:

  • Patrol buildings and grounds.
  • Maintain campus security and follow lock protocols.
  • Provides individual and group escorts to and from parking areas.
  • Identifies and removes unauthorized individuals from property.
  • Enforces campus parking policies/cites violations.
  • Executes Courtesy Patrol policies, procedures, and standards with excellence.
  • Provides campus directions to facility visitors.
  • Interacts with police, fire personnel, EMS, patients, visitors, and staff.
  • Completes incident / offense reports and composes narratives by performing investigations, recording observations, taking statements, gathering information, citing occurrences, and utilizing surveillance activities.
  • Make eye contact and greet all people with respect.
  • Responds to calls for service and emergency situations with urgency and professionalism.
  • Assesses the situation and utilizes appropriate de-escalation measures.
  • Utilizes critical thinking skills.
  • Responds to and activates the appropriate emergency response codes.
  • Supports activities and events by utilizing appropriate crowd control techniques representative of UGM.
  • Work overnights, weekends, evening hours, and holidays as needed by the organization.
  • The central job functions of this position are not limited to the duties listed above.

Qualifications / What You Bring:

  • 3-5 years of security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with security equipment.
  • Ability to handle physical workload (walking/standing)
  • Bilingual: Spanish Speaking a plus
  • Level 2 License preferred
  • Strong attention to detail
  • An ability to connect with people from diverse backgrounds at varying levels of understanding.
  • Problem Sensitivity — The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem.
  • Deductive Reasoning — The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense.
  • Flexibility of Closure — The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material.
  • Inductive Reasoning — The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events).
  • A clean driving record.


“As part of the screening process, you may be asked to provide a pastoral reference. Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a Christian organization that seeks to hire people who align with our beliefs in Jesus Christ. We welcome all Christian denominations into the mission.”

jobs.title: Watch Officer, Global Security Operations Center (Night Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon’s Global Security Department, a department that supports the U.S. MTO Management & Executive Protection Team in Fort Worth, TX.

The Watch Officer for the Global Security Operations Center is responsible for executing operational tasks that support secure, efficient, and compliant security operations. This role ensures seamless physical security for Alcon’s property, assets, and employees by following established procedures, applying advanced skills, and using sound judgment.

Specifics Include:

  • Dispatches and coordinates responses impacting Alcon’s assets globally.
  • Monitors the access control system and supports badge access functions.
  • Monitors intelligence providers, global news, and open-source media for events that could impact Alcon’s operations and disseminates relevant information to leadership.
  • Actively seeks and communicates information on incidents that may affect global sites.
  • Uses SOPs, training, research resources, and critical thinking skills to escalate events appropriately to Watch Officer Lead(s) and GSOC manager.
  • Produces clear, concise written incident reports summarizing events, impacts, and response status.
  • Maintains continuous and accurate documentation of events throughout the shift.
  • Understands Alcon’s global footprint to anticipate operational and organizational needs.
  • Receives, evaluates, and disseminates information from on-site security, global points of contact, employees, and other sources, engaging Watch Officer Lead(s) when needed.
  • Works effectively with security team members and intelligence analyst in a collaborative environment.
  • Suggests program improvements to Watch Officer Lead(s) or the GSOC Manager.
  • Tracks and reports on metrics related to operational output and deliverables.
  • Performs tasks related to designing, developing, and maintaining security processes and system integrations.
  • Supports actions and tasks related to incident management, risk and intelligence, protective services, investigations, and aviation security.
  • Follows product concerns, crisis management protocols, escalation plans, and required training.
  • Responds appropriately to safety and security assistance requests, and coordinates with local law enforcement.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Work Hours: Weekend shift consists of three 12‑hour shifts totaling 36 hours, running from 6:00 PM CST to 6:00 AM CST each day from Friday evening through Monday morning
  • Travel Requirements: 0%
  • Location: Onsite
  • Sponsorship & Relocation: Not Available

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience in incident response, security operations or a related field required, with a demonstrated history of excellence and reliability.
  • Ability to utilize critical thinking skills to operate effectively with a medium degree of autonomy and moderate supervision.
  • Intelligence analysis and/or threat assessment knowledge.
  • General understanding of site security operations.
  • Intermediate communication skills.
  • Intermediate attention to detail and ability to follow protocols with the drive to progress and learn.
  • Able to provide clear and concise verbal briefings.
  • Familiarity with global affairs and events, with the ability to contextualize against Alcon’s global footprint.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Knowledge of Google Earth and Maps.
  • Effective problem-solving skills.
  • Fast learner and ability to coordinate several initiatives simultaneously.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize work with little supervision.
  • Ability to adhere to timelines and deadlines with effective time management skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain positive professional rapport with other Watch Officers, Watch Officer Lead(s), GSOC Manager, R&I Director, the greater security leadership, and client stakeholders.
  • Accurate typing and written skills.

HOW YOU CAN THRIVE:

  • Collaborate with teammates to share standard processes and findings as work evolves
  • See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities
  • Join Alcon’s mission to provide outstanding, innovative products and solutions to improve sight, improve lives, and grow your career!
  • Alcon provides robust benefits package including health, life, retirement, flexible time off and much more.

Alcon Careers

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose.
While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.
As a Security Officer Armed Vehicle Patrol Security Clearance in Fort Worth, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Aero/Defense, and more.
Join Allied Universal as an armed patrol officer at a leading aerospace and defense location, where you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, remain visible to help deter security-related incidents, and deliver outstanding customer service and communication.
This driving post offers the opportunity to support a dynamic environment with professionalism, teamwork, and integrity while contributing to a caring, reliable, and innovative culture.

* Provide customer service to personnel, visitors, and/or contractors by carrying out security-related procedures, site‑specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities at an aerospace and defense location.

jobs.title: Security Officer Job at Sundance Square in Fort Worth
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Sundance Square Security is seeking qualified individuals looking for a rewarding career in the heart of downtown Fort Worth.
Our dedicated professionals are committed to the safety of our visitors and businesses.
They are alert, aware and adept at evaluating and responding to situations, and masters of de-escalation.
We welcome all members of our community and visitors who come to the Square to enjoy shopping, dining, and the entertainment.
We enjoy great benefits, a competitive salary and ongoing professional development in a collaborative team culture.
Our Security Officers monitor the properties and protect our valued staff, visitors, tenants, and inventory.
The primary duties of this position include but are not limited to:
* Patrol property on foot and/or bicycle, securing personnel, assets, buildings, gates, and fence perimeter in all weather conditions.
* Respond to alarms and incidents that threaten the safety of others or could harm the properties.
* Investigate and take the appropriate lawfully action as authorized by the corporate policy on accidents, incidents, trespassing, suspicious activities, safety and fire incidents.
* Control and monitor surveillance equipment, and perform building and equipment inspections.
* Guard access points, permitting or refusing entry, restraining trespassers, and direct heavy traffic during start and end of business hours.
* Complete daily reports, including relevant information, observations, surveillance footage, and signatures.
* Secure all doors, windows, and exits, depending on shift.
* Comply with all company policies and all applicable safety rules and requirements.
* Contribute to a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding security and company procedures.
Company Description
Sundance Square has become a model for urban development, creating a large cultural and economic impact on the city of Fort Worth.
